preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.

Each subsequent line contains exactly four integers: A₁, D, L, R, where A₁ is the first term of the arithmetic progression, D is the common difference, and L, R define the range of indices (1 ≤ L ≤ R).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= int(line.split()[3]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[3]) <= 10**18 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, constraints are: 1 ≤ A₁ ≤ 10^9, 0 ≤ D ≤ 10^9, 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^18.

postconditions.description: Each line of output is a single integer representing the sum of F(Aᵢ) for L ≤ i ≤ R.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_line) == sum(F(int(A1 + (i-1)*D)) for i in range(L, R+1)) for stdout_line, (A1, D, L, R) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the sum of F(Aᵢ) where Aᵢ = A₁ + (i-1)*D for i in [L, R], and F(X) is the digital root of X (repeated sum of digits until a single digit is obtained).
